title: 124. Network Delay Time

examples.explanation: From node 2, the signal reaches all 4 nodes; the longest travel time is 2.
Node 2 has no outgoing edges, so it cannot reach node 1. Since not all nodes receive the signal, the answer is -1.

hints: The arrival time at each node is its shortest-path distance from k.
All weights are positive, so Dijkstra's algorithm with a min-heap is appropriate.
After finding all shortest distances, the answer is their maximum; an unreached node makes the answer -1.
